name: Gotta Find That Dragon Ball!
findings: The current independent PQ transcription explicitly lists Holstein Shock, Spinning Blade, and Fighting Pose D among PQ15 rewards.
The repository already contains a PQ15 relationship for Holstein Shock and Fighting Pose D.
Spinning Blade has a documented acquisition-source conflict in prior research: PQ15 Ultimate Finish evidence versus TP Medal Shop evidence.

Spinning Blade is present in an indexed Strike Evasives catalog but is not present as a canonical record in docs/data/skills.json, so no new canonical relationship edge was invented during this reconciliation.
next: Recover or reconcile the canonical Spinning Blade identity if direct canonical evidence becomes available; otherwise continue the next PQ cross-domain boundary.
